_comment: On-device model packs offered by Ledgr AI. Served to the app at raw.githubusercontent.com/mbell003638/Ledgr-AI/main/model-packs.json. Editing this file adds, removes, or repoints a pack without shipping a new APK. Rules: downloadUrl must be https; filename must be a bare name with no path separators; capabilities drive routing, so never claim vision a pack does not have; minAppVersion hides a pack from older builds that cannot run it.
